answer: Unique-artifact filing bond: each identity files a willow relic and its fable, its origin tale, on the public grove log, locking 70 credits. A pulse audit re-checks 10% of filings each epoch; a copied fable or duplicate willow relic burns its bond. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, vs 40,000 pool. Rented relics fail: their fable is key-bound to the carver. Honest agents file once, keep the bond.
